name: Lindon County Courthouse
notes: Interpretation (no reference image): a two-story neoclassical red-brick courthouse on a rusticated stone basement, stone quoins, belt course, keystone lintels and arched second-floor windows; a hexastyle giant-order portico with a pediment and oculus over a broad flight of granite steps; slate hip roof; a white cupola with four clock faces (no numerals), an octagonal colonnaded lantern and a verdigris copper dome. The site-specs method puts the front toward Jefferson Street (heading 178.1), not Second Street (its address); the Atlas building is 40.01 x 60.03 m with the long side running back from the street.
